name: Wrike
summary: Work management for mid-to-large teams running cross-functional projects: reporting, workflows, approvals and resource management.
best_for: mid-to-large teams running complex, cross-functional projects that need robust reporting, workflows and resource management
skip_if: you're a small team that just wants a simple kanban board — a lighter tool is faster to adopt and cheaper
honest_knock: It's powerful and scales to complex, cross-team portfolios, but that power brings a learning curve and a per-seat cost that climbs — small teams often find it heavier than they need next to a simpler board tool.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month, for 2 to 15 users
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-25) A permanent free plan at $0 per user, with no user cap named on the plan card; Team $10 per user a month for 2 to 15 users; Business $25 per user a month for 5 to 200 users. Pinnacle and Apex publish no amount at all — both carry only a Contact us button and the line "Connect with us for pricing". Business and every tier above it is sold as an annual subscription only. Seats are bought in blocks: groups of five up to 30 seats, groups of 10 from 30 to 100, groups of 25 above 100. Self-service checkout covers Team and Business up to 15 users with no add-ons; beyond that the purchase goes through a Wrike representative. All prices are listed in US dollars and exclude local taxes.
